notes: Black Friday offer statics from 5 user-supplied format references (2026-10-27): shelf hero, split SAVE 60%, buy/get winter scene, pink 60% card, customer collage. Lead offer EITHER 60% OFF SITEWIDE (O48_01, 02, 04) OR buy 2 pairs + free socks and travel bag (O48_03, 05). No prices, promo codes or unconfirmed counts (the refs' '£29.99', 'Code BF10', '200,000+ pairs', 'sold out 3x' and '30,000+' are not used). No SHOP NOW buttons, no doctor imagery.
